name: 0DTE Cash-Secured Put
summary: Sell a same-day-expiry put fully secured by cash, harvesting one day of the steepest theta on the board.

legs.strike_rule: Delta -0.08 to -0.18, computed locally (Alpaca returns no greeks on 0DTE)

max_loss: (strike - credit) x 100 in a same-day crash; realistically bounded by how far the index can fall intraday, but a 3% flush produces a loss many times the credit

greeks.delta: +0.08 to +0.18 at entry, can reach +0.95 within hours
greeks.theta: the highest available per day, fully realised by the bell
greeks.vega: small, but a vol spike during a selloff compounds the delta loss

when_to_use: SPY/QQQ only, on days with no scheduled macro catalyst. This is the short side of the 0DTE trade, where research indicates the structural edge lies - but the edge is small and the tail is real.
entry_rules: SPY or QQQ only; cash >= strike x 100 x contracts reserved and verified before submission
Delta -0.08 to -0.18, computed locally with Black-Scholes using intraday T in fractions of a trading day and a locally estimated IV (Alpaca supplies no greeks or IV on 0DTE at any tier)
Credit >= $0.20 absolute; skip the day otherwise
SKIP the day if: VIX > 25, overnight gap < -0.75%, FOMC/CPI/NFP/PPI release scheduled, or the index is below its lower 20-period Bollinger band
Maximum 1 position per day; maximum notional (strike x 100) <= 20% of equity
Daily 0DTE loss limit shared with all 0DTE strategies: -1.5% of equity ends the session
management_rules: Buy to close at 70% of the credit
Hard stop: buy to close at 2.5x the credit received
Buy to close immediately if the index trades below the strike at any point after 13:00 ET
No rolling at 0 DTE - close only
exit_rules: Buy to close at 70% of credit, at the 2.5x stop, or on the below-strike trigger after 13:00 ET

ABSOLUTE NEVER-ASSIGN RULE: buy to close by 15:30 ET if the index is within 0.5% of the strike, and by 15:45 ET unconditionally if ITM or within 0.25%. An ITM 0DTE short put left at the bell is assigned that evening and delivers 100 shares (roughly $65,000 of SPY per contract) against the account overnight
The assignment check must run on a wall-clock timer, not only on price events, because a quiet drift into the strike in the last 20 minutes is the most common way this fails
assignment_risk: HIGHEST cadence and highest urgency in the bank. There is no next day to fix it. Share delivery of a full SPY round lot would consume most of a $50k account's buying power.
buying_power: Full cash securing self-imposed: strike x 100 per contract.
common_mistakes: Selling 0DTE puts on a macro release day; not having a wall-clock timer for the 15:30/15:45 flatten; sizing by premium collected rather than by the notional that assignment would deliver.
zero_dte_notes: Short 0DTE puts carry the structural edge the research identifies (median daily move is smaller than what buyers need) but with a left tail that a small number of days can dominate. Backtest over at least 2 years including Feb 2018, Mar 2020 and Aug 2024 style shocks before sizing up.
